Bone_Crushing_Hyena_Jaws.description: These jaws, evolved from the savage lineage of hyenas, are a fearsome amalgamation of bone-crushing power and cunning, granting unparalleled strength in battle while slightly hindering agility, and bestowing the skills to sunder armor and grapple foes with brutal efficiency.

Elongated_Precision_Snapping_Muzzle.description: This elongated, precision-tuned muzzle is a marvel of biomechanical engineering, its sleek greyhound-like jaw lined with razor-sharp canines that snap with deadly accuracy, enhancing both the agility and precision of the creature or character it adorns.

Serrated_Flesh_Rending_Teeth.description: The Serrated_Flesh_Rending_Teeth, a fearsome adaptation of an African wild dog's maw, features razor-sharp canines that slice through flesh with brutal efficiency, granting its bearer enhanced strength and accuracy, while also inflicting a bleeding effect on their prey.

Glandular_Rabid_Infectious_Maw.description: The Glandular Rabid Infectious Maw is a grotesque cephalon mutation, a toxic canine head with razor-sharp fangs and bulging venom glands that secrete a potent neurotoxin, capable of spreading fear and releasing a choking poison cloud with a mere snarl.

Underbite_Gripping_Bulldog_Jaws.description: Equipped with a monstrous underbite, these bulldog jaws are a fearsome cephalon capable of biting with unparalleled strength, their powerful grip making it nearly impossible for foes to escape, though the sheer ferocity slightly hinders precision strikes.

Cybernetic_Alloy_Bite_Mechanism.description: Embedded within the gnarled cephalon, this cybernetic alloy bite mechanism fuses raw canine ferocity with mechanical precision, enhancing the user's strength and natural armor while granting the devastating skills of Sunder and Block, turning the head into a fearsome weapon and shield.

Prehensile_Licking_Tongue.description: This grotesque mutation sprouts a serpentine, prehensile tongue tipped with a barbed, sticky pad, capable of both ensnaring prey and secreting a pheromone-laced saliva to mesmerize and draw in unwary victims, enhancing the bearer's reach and dexterity in the process.

Necrotic_Soul_Devouring_Maw.description: Emerging from the depths of the necrotic realm, the Necrotic Soul Devouring Maw is a spectral cephalon with the visage of a canine, its ethereal jaws pulsating with a sickly glow as it whispers of arcane terrors, sapping the courage of the living while it feasts on the spectral essence of the dead.

Acoustic_Howling_Resonator_Maw.description: Enveloped in shadow, the Acoustic Howling Resonator Maw is a gaping orifice within the cephalon of a twisted, otherworldly canine, its jaws lined with serrated, chime-like teeth that ring with a haunting melody when agitated, echoing through the depths of the dark realm and striking fear into the hearts of all who hear it.

Venomous_Vampiric_Fangs.description: Emerging from the twisted, fleshy overgrowth of its cephalon, the Venomous_Vampiric_Fangs are a pair of elongated, razor-sharp canines that drip with a noxious venom, capable of draining vitality and spreading a cloud of toxic mist with each vicious bite.
